answer.evidence: Total LOS since 10-23 14:00 with Tx normal and no light at B-ODF indicates OSP break. OTDR from A and B both end at ~20.05 km fibre (~19.5 km route, between SC-05 18.392 km and SC-06 22.568 km) with strong Fresnel reflection and no continuity. Identical end at 1310 nm and 1550 nm rules out macrobend (which is wavelength-dependent). Coincides with road works around km 19.

evidence_refs.quote: Road works reported somewhere around route km 19.
